pharmacopoeia: Ayurvedic Pharmacopoeia of India (API) & WHO Herbal Guidelines

lead_pb.standard: API Part-I / WHO Guidelines for Quality Control of Herbal Medicines
lead_pb.toxicity_effects: Encephalopathy, peripheral neuropathy, microcytic anemia, nephrotoxicity

arsenic_as.standard: API Part-I / WHO Guidelines for Quality Control of Herbal Medicines
arsenic_as.toxicity_effects: Skin hyperpigmentation, keratosis, peripheral vascular disease, hepatotoxicity

cadmium_cd.standard: API Part-I / WHO Guidelines for Quality Control of Herbal Medicines
cadmium_cd.toxicity_effects: Renal tubular dysfunction, osteomalacia (Itai-itai disease), pulmonary damage

mercury_hg.standard: API Part-I / WHO Guidelines for Quality Control of Herbal Medicines
mercury_hg.toxicity_effects: Acrodynia, tremors, erethism, nephrotic syndrome, acute tubular necrosis

rasa_shastra_formulations.name: Arogyavardhini Vati
rasa_shastra_formulations.toxicity_alert: Contains processed heavy metal bhasmas (Tamra, Parada). Exceeds raw metal limits; therapeutic use requires strictly purified Bhasma adhering to API standards.
rasa_shastra_formulations.regulatory_status: Schedule E(1) of Drugs and Cosmetics Rules 1945 - Requires Medical Supervision

rasa_shastra_formulations.name: Rasa Sindura
rasa_shastra_formulations.toxicity_alert: Classical Kupipakwa Rasayana containing mercuric sulphide (HgS). Chronic non-standard intake causes cumulative mercury deposition.
rasa_shastra_formulations.regulatory_status: Schedule E(1) Poisonous Substances in Ayurvedic System

rasa_shastra_formulations.name: Makaradhwaja
rasa_shastra_formulations.toxicity_alert: Gold and mercury based Kupipakwa preparation. Must be administered with specific Anupana (honey, betel leaf) strictly under Vaidya supervision.
rasa_shastra_formulations.regulatory_status: Schedule E(1) of Drugs and Cosmetics Rules 1945

rasa_shastra_formulations.name: Kajjali
herbo_mineral_elements: Equal parts Shuddha Parada (Mercury) and Shuddha Gandhaka (Sulphur)
rasa_shastra_formulations.toxicity_alert: Black sulphide of mercury. Fundamental base for mercurial formulations. Must show negative free mercury test (Nishchandratva).
rasa_shastra_formulations.regulatory_status: Schedule E(1) of Drugs and Cosmetics Rules 1945

rasa_shastra_formulations.name: Vasant Kusumakar Rasa
rasa_shastra_formulations.toxicity_alert: Contains Naga Bhasma (Lead) and Vanga Bhasma (Tin). Must meet Bhasma Pariksha tests (Rekhapurnatva, Varitara) to ensure zero free lead ions.
rasa_shastra_formulations.regulatory_status: Schedule E(1) - Prescription Only Ayurvedic Medicine

rasa_shastra_formulations.name: Ekangaveera Rasa
rasa_shastra_formulations.toxicity_alert: Complex herbo-mineral formulation containing lead, copper, tin, and mercury calces. Indicated for neuromuscular conditions.
rasa_shastra_formulations.regulatory_status: Schedule E(1) - Strictly Under Clinical Supervision

rasa_shastra_formulations.name: Tribhuvankirti Rasa
rasa_shastra_formulations.toxicity_alert: Contains Aconite (Vatsanabha) and Cinnabar. High cardiac toxicity risk if Vatsanabha Shodhana (purification in cow milk/gomutra) is substandard.
rasa_shastra_formulations.regulatory_status: Schedule E(1) Toxic Plant & Mineral Formulation
